what is the reason? because they pull each other apart
Rav: everything stated in the passage of rebuke is done for a woman in childbirth on Shabbat
'and as for your birth, on the day you were born your navel was not cut, nor were you washed in water to cleanse you, nor salted at all, nor swaddled at all' (Ezek 16:4)
'your birth, on the day you were born' -- from here, that one delivers the child on Shabbat
'your navel was not cut' -- from here, that one cuts the umbilical cord on Shabbat
'nor were you washed in water to cleanse you' -- from here, that one washes the child on Shabbat
'nor salted at all' -- from here, that one salts the child on Shabbat
'nor swaddled at all' -- from here, that one swaddles the child on Shabbat
